findings: Buys: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it bought beat SPY by 0.24% on average (49 buys, 51% of them ahead of SPY; t = 0.5, within noise).
Sells: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it sold beat SPY by 0.32%, so selling gave that up (110 sells; t = -0.7, within noise).
Decision IC: on the 30 days it traded, what it bought ranked against what it sold and left alone by a mean rank IC of -0.007 with the next five days' returns (IC IR -0.05, t = -0.3, within noise).
Holdings IC: the weights it held after each of 50 decision days had a mean rank IC of 0.020 with the next five days' returns (t = 0.8, within noise).
Factor exposures: market 0.26 (t 13.9), size -0.04 (t -1.0), growth -0.17 (t -3.0), momentum 0.05 (t 2.2); together they explain 59% of the daily variation (R²).
Of its -5.7% a year over T-bills (arithmetic mean): market -5.1%, growth +3.0%, momentum +0.3%, size +0.1%; the alpha left is -4.0% a year (t = -0.9, within noise).
Verdict: the exposures account for -1.7% a year of it, and the -4.0% a year left over is not significant: one period of daily returns cannot tell it from luck.
P&L: -$4,369 in all, -$5,316 from 43 positions and +$947 of interest on idle cash.
By holding period: 61+ days made the most (+$3,507, 9 positions); 11-20 days lost the most (-$6,134, 8 positions).
By sector: Industrials made the most (+$1,266, 7 positions); Technology lost the most (-$3,507, 4 positions).
By stock: JNJ made the most (+$1,232, 3 positions); NVDA lost the most (-$1,478, 1 position).
By market regime of the previous close: risk-on 11 days -3.8% (SPY -5.1%); neutral 6 days -0.2% (SPY -3.3%); uncertain 162 days -5.6% (SPY -19.0%); risk-off 72 days +5.5% (SPY +9.5%).
News: 9 positions opened on news made -$167, the other 34 -$5,149; 5 positions closed on news made -$563; over the five days from the fill, news-triggered buys beat SPY by 0.50% (t 0.4).

Concentration: the positions lost $5,316 in all; the best was MRK bought 2022-09-15 and sold 2022-12-02, +$1,132. Had the best position made nothing, the run would have returned -5.5% instead of -4.4%.
